candidates.description: This vector represents biological, ecological, and natural science terminology across multiple languages.
This vector represents word roots, prefixes, and stems associated with various semantic categories.
This vector activates on common Latin-alphabet letter combinations and short phonetic sub-word suffixes.
This vector activates on prefixes and roots related to French-derived or Latinate descriptive adjectives and nouns.
This feature vector activates strongly on names of countries and continents, predominantly in Africa.
This vector activates on word roots and suffixes containing the letter sequence "if" across various English and Latin-derived vocabulary.
The tokens represent words and word fragments associated with the Mediterranean region, its culture, and related historical or geographical terms.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing the common letter sequence "el" or closely related morphological roots.
This vector represents common prefixes and morphological roots derived from Latin/Romance languages involving comparison, containment, and accompaniment.
This feature activates on tokens containing the Latin root for keeping, preserving, or gathering together, particularly variations of the prefix "conserv-" or similar phonetic fragments.
